page.notes: The Hebrew words are small and partly blurred, so every Hebrew form is marked [?] and should be checked against the scan. The top markers (two Hebrew letters flanking the centre) are not transcribed as a running head. The entry "visitabitur" that begins in the left column runs over the column break into the right column and is written here as one paragraph. The Hebrew of the first and the last entries and the root in "splendor, Rad." are the least certain readings.
